genre_rules.書: Response-unit segmentation after restoring quotation boundaries (인용 경계 복원 후 응답 단위).
genre_rules.雜著: Completeness and minimality, plus mandatory citation-speaker attribution and cautionary marker (인용 화자·경고 필수).

metadata_schema.genre: One of 書 (formal letter), 與 (informal letter), 雜著 (treatise)
metadata_schema.title: Title of the source work (편명)
metadata_schema.recipient: Addressee, for 書/與 letters (null for 雜著)
metadata_schema.grounding: Grounding grade: '직접근거' (direct evidence, Nosa's own words) | '인용구간' (a span Nosa quotes from another party)
metadata_schema.citation_speaker: Attributed speaker/source when grounding is '인용구간' (null for direct evidence)
metadata_schema.citation_span_label: Label of the quoted span, e.g. the cited work (null for direct evidence)
metadata_schema.key_concepts: List of key concepts appearing in the segment

citation: Lee, Si-yeon. "Building a Nosa AI from the Nosajip Corpus..." (in preparation).
